entities.name: Tuya Bearclaw
entities.description: Warrior of Clan Atarka from the current Tarkir timeline who tamed a bear and rides it into battle.

entities.name: Surrak the Hunt Caller
entities.description: Clan Atarka leader who trusts Tuya more than anyone.

entities.name: Clan Atarka
entities.description: Dragon-worshipping clan of Tarkir to which Tuya belongs.

entities.name: Diaglu
entities.description: Bear cub Tuya spared and tamed, which she rides into battle.

events.summary: Tuya and her fighters find a lone bear cub whose mother was slain by a dragon.
events.quote: Tuya and her fighters stumbled upon a lone bear cub

events.summary: Tuya spares the cub, tames it, names it Diaglu and rides it into battle.
events.quote: Tuya succeeded in making the beast her companion, named it Diaglu

events.summary: Forbidden from taking the name Dragonclaw, Tuya is given the name Bearclaw and the respect of Clan Atarka.
events.quote: Tuya was instead bequeathed the name "Bearclaw"

relations.note: She is a warrior of the clan.
relations.quote: is a warrior of Clan Atarka

relations.note: Surrak trusts her above all others.
relations.quote: There is none that Surrak the Hunt Caller trusts more than Tuya Bearclaw.
Tuya succeeded in making the beast her companion
